verdict.rationale: Daytona is a sandbox/infrastructure platform, not an AI agent; its MCP integration runs in the opposite direction — Daytona exposes an MCP server that agents (Claude, Cursor, Windsurf) connect to, so Daytona's tools can be used by agents rather than Daytona itself consuming external MCP servers' tools. There is no evidence of Daytona acting as an MCP client, making this client-side 'plug in MCP servers' story a wrong axis for this product category.
